latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Trimmer Free.

- Upload and trim MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB with quick, AI-driven edits.
- Easy, chat-based video editing: just describe the cuts you want.
- Automatic session and token management; free 7-day trial credits included.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers trimmed videos in 20–40 seconds (for short clips).
- Simple export with MP4 download; no app install required.
- Supports text overlays, background music, and multiple video/audio formats.
